Application Data.NAME: Doughy Delights Bakery
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Doughy Delights Bakery specializes in producing a wide variety of freshly baked goods including artisan breads, pastries, cookies, and bagels. We also offer custom cakes for special occasions, catering services for local events, and a small café area where customers can enjoy coffee and light snacks. Our operations include the sourcing of high-quality ingredients, baking on-site daily, and a commitment to sustainability through eco-friendly packaging and waste reduction practices.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2022, a fire broke out in the kitchen due to a malfunctioning oven, causing damage to equipment and inventory. The estimated loss was $2,500.00, and the claim was closed after repairs were completed. On November 10, 2021, a slip-and-fall incident occurred in the café area, resulting in a settlement of $1,000.00, which is currently resolved.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Security system with central monitoring, 24-hour surveillance cameras, and on-site watchpersons during operating hours. Additional fencing installed around the perimeter of the property.
